description: This Java class defines the VisitAttributeType entity within the OpenMRS project, representing a customizable extension to the Visit class with persistence annotations and attribute overrides.

classes.name: VisitAttributeType
classes.description: An entity class representing the type of an attribute associated with a visit, extending BaseAttributeType and implementing AttributeType for the Visit entity, with JPA annotations for persistence.
